mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% over the past month signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and PAYEMS both rising) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient and is statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive increases in the federal funds rate (indicating an active monetary tightening cycle) lead to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increased by >=0.25% in last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has increased by >=0.25% in the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) over the past month signals increasing price pressures that may prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% in the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates strong consumer demand and potential economic overheating, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and CPIAUCSL both rising) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient and is statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by strong GDP growth and low unemployment), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened risk of a policy-induced slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% and UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
